scope: Exact root original-input observation helpers. Root is the existing generation executor, not a third output-review slot or a new agent. Four shared atomic source reservations per finite group; actual raw/nearest views and complete are mandatory, and only immutable intents are queued for the normal sole-producer gates. The queue-reviewed-canvas helper FAILED its attempt1 guard before writing anything; it is preserved as an abandoned attempt, never permission to execute it again. Later manual source evidence was registered separately without changing any frozen attempt. Completion source shown here is the subsequent version with explicit full-painted-rectangle prefix; first three actual completed groups predate that prefix and keep their original descriptions unchanged.

"""Root producer observes a finite source group while the two reviewers review PNGs."""
import json,os,re,sys,uuid
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import candidates,extract_original
from PIL import Image
folder=ROOT/'runtime/fresh-source-observations'
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')
run=owner['run_id'];assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',run)
assert owner['machine_id']==machine_id()
state=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
assert state['status']=='running' and state['machine_id']==machine_id()
assert not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
for p in (folder/'allocations').glob('*.json'):
    old=read_json(p)
    if old['slot']=='producer':assert (ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{old["tag"]}.json').exists(),'Unfinished producer original observation; reconcile before allocating more'
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches']
prepared=sum(len(read_json(ROOT/item['jobs'])) for item in plan[state['next_index']:])
intended=sum(len(read_json(p).get('expected_source_keys',[])) for p in (ROOT/'runtime/production-queue/preparation/pending').glob('*.json'))
assert prepared+intended<=8,'Useful prepared supply exists; do not over-reserve originals'
tag='fresh-observed-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'-producer-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
selected=[];reserved=folder/'reservations';reserved.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for item in candidates(ROOT):
    path=reserved/(item['key']+'.json')
    try:fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL)
    except FileExistsError:continue
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        item=extract_original(ROOT,item)
        json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'reserved_at_utc':utc_now(),'source':item},stream,ensure_ascii=True)
    selected.append(item)
    if len(selected)==4:break
assert selected,'No unreserved allowed original; do not fabricate one'
allocation=folder/'allocations'/(tag+'.json');assert not allocation.exists()
body={'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'created_at_utc':utc_now(),'sources':selected,
    'producer_supply_context':{'run_id':run,'next_index':state['next_index'],'prepared_requests':prepared,'pending_preparation_requests':intended},
    'scope':'One finite group of original inputs actually observed by the root generation executor during its service/queue wait. Existing a/b portrait reviewers remain the only two output-review slots. No new agent, output approval, image call, retry claim, journal preparation or canonical portrait write. Atomic shared source reservations prevent duplicate claims; normal complete and sole-producer preparation gates remain mandatory.'}
write_json(allocation,body)
views=[]
for item in selected:
    with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:
        image=opened.convert('RGBA');alpha=image.getchannel('A').getextrema()
        target=ROOT/f'runtime/{tag}-{item["key"][:8]}-nearest4.png'
        image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
        views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(alpha),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
result={'tag':tag,'allocation':allocation.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'allocation_sha256':file_sha256(allocation),'config':f'runtime/{tag}-observations.json','sources':selected,'views':views,'created_at_utc':body['created_at_utc'],'mascot_reference_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png')}
write_json(ROOT/'runtime/producer-originals-current-20261025.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True))

"""Persist actual source-canvas evidence; never mutate attempts or call images."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from mod_nailong.tools.prepare_ready_art_reviews import reviewed_canvas_reasons
key='72a8adc2fb4ccc421989fd613d1141d5a8ca53dd1272affc836be42cbb8c1e33'
report=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/resumed-20261024-rollinga104-agent-review.json'
observations=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-source-observations/fresh-observed-20261025T015851-producer-0d2f4fdf.json'
assert file_sha256(report)=='5130c5c16bb4bd4104e3bbc557752a9d85dcc206cb0ebc1eeadb632bcf21d42b'
assert file_sha256(observations)=='7b9f8bab9da0493c8338dc09c27f0b17381095f3c6293695e30b16dc6bb7ddc1'
body=read_json(report);entry=body['decisions'][0]
assert entry['source_sha256']==key and entry['decision']=='rejected'
source=ROOT/f'runtime/references/{key}.png'
assert file_sha256(source)==entry['original_png_sha256']=='bfa22319a2d49df63f75fda56057ff9d322467ee065c49d972894752279f20e3'
with Image.open(source) as opened:extrema=list(opened.convert('RGBA').getchannel('A').getextrema())
assert extrema==[243,255]
reason='Root actually viewed the exact156x210 source and nearest4 in fresh-observed-20261025T015851-producer-0d2f4fdf (view interval starts01:59:20Z). All four corners/edges are part of a COMPLETE dark grey painted rectangular canvas, no exterior figure cutout. Original convertedPNG SHA256 '+file_sha256(source)+', source alpha243..255. Reviewer a104 independently viewed exact source/full raw/white/cyan/alpha and rejected47a56cc1 for visible lost top backing. Preserve full opaque background/head/clothes. The first transparent tool flag was a preparation classification error; original frozen attempts/flags/outputs remain unchanged.'
path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/reviewed-source-canvas.json';assert not path.exists()
proof={'actually_viewed':True,'complete_painted_rectangle':True,'original_png_sha256':file_sha256(source),'original_alpha_extrema':extrema,'opaque_canvas_reason':reason,'evidence':[{'path':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(p)} for p in [observations,report]]}
write_json(path,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'scope':'Explicit manual source evidence for later NEW art requests only. Never rewrite frozen requests, infer canvas from alpha threshold or approve an output. Each selected source and immutable evidence file must match its SHA.','sources':{key:proof}})
assert reviewed_canvas_reasons(ROOT,[(report,entry)])[key]['opaque_canvas_reason']==reason
history=read_json(ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/generation-requests/{key}.json')['attempts']
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-root-original-canvas-classification.json';assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'source_sha256':key,'first_actual_attempt':1,'first_actual_prompt_sha256':history[0]['prompt_sha256'],'first_actual_transparent_background':history[0]['transparent_background'],'first_output_sha256':entry['generated_fullsize_sha256'],'actual_independent_review':body,'reason':'Root used a semantically explicit complete-canvas description but missed the fresh preparer exact literal prefix Standalone full painted rectangle.; alpha243 consequently selected the wrong transparent flag. This produced actual visible backing loss. Subsequent new original observations use the exact explicit prefix only after viewing all corners. The registered source evidence lets later NEW automatic art preparations request the correct opaque canvas. No previous source observation, frozen prompt or toolflag is rewritten.','canvas_evidence':proof,'latest_attempt_snapshot':{'number':history[-1]['number'],'status':history[-1]['status'],'transparent_background':history[-1]['transparent_background']},'local_queue_guard_failure':'An earlier local helper tried to queue an explicit repair, but the existing producer had already prepared attempt2. The helper asserted before writing any canvas, selection, intent or audit; no image replay or canonical edit. Exact helper remains in runtime/queue-reviewed-canvas-72a8adc2-20261025.py; separate reliable failure timestamp was not saved.','new_image_calls_here':0,'content_retry_claims':0,'status':'manual_source_canvas_evidence_registered_for_new_art_requests','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'registry':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'registry_sha256':file_sha256(path),'audit':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'latest_attempt':history[-1]['number'],'image_calls':0,'frozen_attempts_modified':0},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Queue the actually reviewed single canvas repair; do not prepare/call images here."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
key='72a8adc2fb4ccc421989fd613d1141d5a8ca53dd1272affc836be42cbb8c1e33'
report='mod_nailong/data/resumed-20261024-rollinga104-agent-review.json'
body=read_json(ROOT/report);entry=body['decisions'][0]
assert entry['source_sha256']==key and entry['decision']=='rejected'
assert file_sha256(ROOT/report)=='5130c5c16bb4bd4104e3bbc557752a9d85dcc206cb0ebc1eeadb632bcf21d42b'
history=read_json(ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/generation-requests/{key}.json')['attempts'];a=history[-1]
assert a['number']==1 and a['status']=='generated_rejected_visual_review'
row=read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits'][key]
assert row['review']=='rejected' and row['generated_fullsize_sha256']==entry['generated_fullsize_sha256']
source=ROOT/f'runtime/references/{key}.png'
assert file_sha256(source)==entry['original_png_sha256']=='bfa22319a2d49df63f75fda56057ff9d322467ee065c49d972894752279f20e3'
tag='root-reviewed-canvas-72a8adc2-20261025';batch='resume-low-reviewed-canvas-72a8adc2-20261025'
canvas=ROOT/f'runtime/{tag}-canvas.json';selection=ROOT/f'runtime/{tag}-selection.json'
reason='Root actually viewed the exact156x210 original and nearest4 at01:59:20Z in fresh-observed-20261025T015851-producer-0d2f4fdf. It has a COMPLETE grey painted rectangular background to all four edges/corners and no exterior figure cutout, source alpha243..255, original convertedPNG SHA256 '+file_sha256(source)+'. Reviewer a104 independently actually viewed exact source/full raw/white/cyan/alpha and rejected output47a56cc1 specifically for visible lost top backing. Restore the original complete fully opaque canvas. The prior tool transparent=true was a preparation classification error, not evidence of an original cutout; original actual prompt/toolflag/output remain unchanged.'
write_json(canvas,{'sources':{key:{'opaque_canvas_reason':reason,'original_png_sha256':file_sha256(source),'manual_report':report,'manual_report_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/report)}}})
write_json(selection,{'schema':'naiwa-exact-art-review-selection-v1','entries':[{'source_sha256':key,'generated_fullsize_sha256':entry['generated_fullsize_sha256'],'report':report,'report_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/report)}]})
intent=ROOT/f'runtime/production-queue/preparation/pending/000-{tag}.json';assert not intent.exists()
preparer=ROOT/'tools/prepare_reviewed_art_repairs.py'
record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'kind':'reviewed_art_repairs','queued_at_utc':utc_now(),'preparer_sha256':file_sha256(preparer),'arguments':[batch,Path(report).name,'1','auto',canvas.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),selection.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()],
    'evidence':[{'path':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(p)} for p in [ROOT/report,canvas,selection]],'expected_jobs_file':f'runtime/production-{batch}-jobs.json','expected_source_keys':[key]}
intent.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with intent.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as stream:json.dump(record,stream,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-root-original-canvas-classification.json'
assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'source_sha256':key,'first_actual_attempt':1,'first_actual_prompt_sha256':a['prompt_sha256'],'first_actual_transparent_background':a['transparent_background'],'first_output_sha256':entry['generated_fullsize_sha256'],'original_observation':'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-source-observations/fresh-observed-20261025T015851-producer-0d2f4fdf.json','reason':'Root used a semantically explicit complete-canvas description but missed the preparer exact literal prefix Standalone full painted rectangle.; alpha243 consequently selected the wrong transparent flag. Subsequent original observations use that explicit prefix only after actually viewing the entire painted rectangle. No previous observation, frozen prompt or failed request was rewritten.','actual_independent_review':body,'queued_intent':record,'canvas_review':read_json(canvas),'selection':read_json(selection),'image_calls_here':0,'content_retry_claims':0,'status':'targeted_reviewed_art_repair_queued_for_same_producer','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'queued':True,'intent':intent.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_sha256':key,'opaque_canvas_reason':reason,'image_calls':0},ensure_ascii=True))
